affirmations.text: I can feel nervous and still take a small step.
I do not need to be perfect to connect with people.
A pause in conversation is normal.
I can learn from uncomfortable moments.
My worth does not depend on everyone's opinion.
It is okay to take things at my own pace.
Small steps add up over time.
Most people are focused on themselves, and many feel nervous too.
I can ask for what I need, kindly and clearly.
